discoveries.title: pt_b35ydgie's period-4 obj + U-shape hand are signatures of 3-way cache misalignment
discoveries.body: Per-frame error decomposition across 11 in-train windows reveals two distinct patterns: (a) mild U-shape on hand (f0=25.9, f01=29.8, middle ~21, f15=26.5 mm hand_vert) and (b) period-4 oscillation on obj_add_s with peaks at f04 (10.7), f08 (11.0), f15 (17.0) and troughs at f02 (4.4), f06 (5.0). Per-window analysis shows the period-4 amplitude varies systematically by sequence — driven by chunk-offset (= tracked_start mod 16): seq00 offset 9 puts window-frame-0 on chunk-floor's 7-frame lat-3 block; seq25 offset 3 on lat-1; seq49 offset 1 on lat-1. Each sequence has different latent-block-vs-PE mismatch geometry, but all consume cache at chunk-misaligned positions.

discoveries.title: Three independent contributors at the head's PE-anchored output positions
discoveries.body: (1) Wan2.2 4× temporal compression + asymmetric up-replication [1,4,4,7] — frames 9-15 ALL share lat 3, capping within-block discrimination. (2) Precompute chunks at sequence frame 0 (precompute_wan22_feats.py:135) but consumption (training + eval) starts at tracked_start. (3) Random training sampler picks ref_pos uniformly from [tracked_start, tracked_end] with stride 1-4 — head was trained on chaotic mixes, not stable structure. The head's additive sinusoidal PE applies rope=0 to window-frame-0 unconditionally, fighting the actual cache geometry on every consumed window.

discoveries.title: Option 2a — tracked-start-aligned cache + chunk-aligned sampler + retrain (spec written, plan ready)
discoveries.body: Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-29-wan22-tracked-start-aligned-cache-design.md (eb79ce3) + 15-task plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-04-29-wan22-tracked-start-aligned-cache.md (4198137). Re-precompute with --chunk-anchor tracked-start (chunks start at tracked_start, drop trailing partial); add chunk_aligned_sampling=True to _sample_frame_indices (stride=1, ref ∈ {tracked_start + 16k}); retrain from scratch on the same pt_b35ydgie 8×H100 / 50-seq sub-01-right / 15k-step envelope. No mini-eval per user 2026-04-29. Decision: hand_vert ≤ 23.60 mm AND obj period-4 amplitude ↓ ≥ 50%.

discoveries.title: 4RC has the same precompute pattern but milder symptom — don't extend 2a to 4rc this iteration
discoveries.body: scripts/hoi3r_v2/precompute_4rc_feats.py:98 uses identical sequence-anchored stride-16 chunking; 4rc-cached training uses the same random-ref + random-stride sampler. But 4RC has 1× compression: each input frame produces ONE distinct feature token, no within-block content sharing. Cross-chunk effect on 4rc-cached is temporal-context flavour shift (each frame's feature inherited context from its own clip's neighbors), not content jumps. Manifests as monotonic cold-start (52→25 mm hand_vert), no period-4. Recommendation: gate any 4rc-aligned retrain on the wan22-aligned outcome — if wan22 wins, 4rc-aligned is a follow-up; if wan22 loses, 4rc-aligned was unlikely to either.
